entries.description: Noticed the three column cells form one statement — unconditional exactly when the dividend grows without bound — rather than three results. No error existed; the three theorems were each correct standalone. The judgement was that the pattern is the finding.

REPEAT of the backtick command-substitution defect from earlier today — same cause, same detection method (reading the message back), three hours after logging it as a correction. The ledger entry did not prevent the recurrence. A recorded lesson is not a control; only the heredoc habit is.

findings.description: The AboveOne column's three cells resolve by ONE criterion: unconditional iff the dividend is unbounded. Nobody asked for a characterisation; it fell out of closing the cells in order.
